title_en: Nature Masterclasses Expert Trainer-led (NMT) Live Workshops, November 2026
summary: All members of Seoul National University, including graduate students, may attend the Nature Masterclasses Expert Trainer-led (NMT) live online workshops, held from Tuesday 10 November to Wednesday 18 November 2026. Participants must register separately for each workshop through its registration link or the QR code in the attached material. They then join the session through the link in the confirmation email.
applies_to: Optional. Open to all members of Seoul National University, including graduate students. Organised by the Undergraduate College (학부대학) under the BK21 Graduate School Innovation Project to strengthen graduate students' research capabilities.

dates.what: NMT live workshop period: 9 sessions in total, 2 hours per session. The schedule for each session is in the attachment, which was not read.

conditions: Participants must register separately for each workshop they wish to attend.
Participants join each session only through the link in the confirmation email sent after registration.
The workshops are held live online via GoToWebinar; no in-person option is stated.
The notice states no registration deadline.
The detailed schedule for each session is only in the attachment, which was not read.
steps: Read the attachment 'NMT 워크숍 홍보자료.pdf' for the schedule of each session. Its content was not read for this translation.

Register for each workshop you wish to attend, one at a time, using its link: Workshop 1: https://attendee.gotowebinar.com/register/4624864123742828126 ; Workshop 2: https://attendee.gotowebinar.com/register/3612392035445159259 ; Workshop 3: https://attendee.gotowebinar.com/register/3294249445472840286 . Alternatively, use the QR code in the attachment.
Check your email for the confirmation message sent after each registration.
At the session time, join the live online session on GoToWebinar through the link in the confirmation email.
translation:
[Undergraduate College / BK21] Information on the Nature Masterclasses Expert Trainer-led (NMT) Programme

The Undergraduate College (학부대학), under the BK21 Graduate School Innovation Project, is running the 'Nature Masterclasses Expert Trainer-led (NMT) Live Workshop' as set out below, to strengthen the research capabilities of graduate students. The workshop is open not only to graduate students but to any member of Seoul National University, so we encourage members of your unit to take part.

A. Programme: Nature Masterclasses Expert Trainer-led (NMT) Live Workshop

B. Eligible participants: Members of Seoul National University (graduate students and others)

C. Schedule: Tuesday 10 November to Wednesday 18 November 2026, 9 sessions in total (2 hours per session)
※ See the attachment for the detailed schedule of each session.

D. Format: Live online sessions (GoToWebinar)

E. How to apply: Register individually through the registration link for each workshop or through the QR code in the attachment.
1) Workshop 1: https://attendee.gotowebinar.com/register/4624864123742828126
2) Workshop 2: https://attendee.gotowebinar.com/register/3612392035445159259
3) Workshop 3: https://attendee.gotowebinar.com/register/3294249445472840286
※ You must register separately for each workshop. Join the session through the link in the confirmation email sent after registration.

Attachment (1 file): NMT 워크숍 홍보자료.pdf (NMT workshop promotional material, 913 KB). The content of this attachment, including the session schedule and QR codes, was not read for this translation.
